vertex_coordinates: Exact original Float64 decimal coordinates; OBJ uses12significant decimal digits; binary STL usesFloat32 as required by its format;3MF preserves original vertex XML literally.

print_transform.application: column-vector world_mm=R*original_scanner_mm+T; positive determinant preserves winding

integration: Direct Float64 integration of every transformed native triangle, including inward-oriented void boundaries; independently performed for each size.

mass_example.material: Explicit nominal PLA density assumption; not a measured material property

stress.dtype: Float32 Pa; NaN means unsupported projection
stress.color_transform: logarithmic; values outside display range clipped for colour only
stress.palette: Matplotlib Turbo256; index256 is unsupported gray
stress.OBJ_materials: Each original triangle uses a material selected from its mean finite vertex scalar; any unsupported corner makes the face gray.
stress.3MF_materials: Original face connectivity and per-corner palette indices; unsupported corners gray.
stress.projection_scope: Scalar field transferred from independent closed-solid volume solve to full native CT surface; not an additional volume solve.

FEM.coordinate_calibration: Original archived L0 points: X,Y retained; Z multiplied by 18/16 before size-specific domain construction.
FEM.size_definition: Exact principal-longitudinal extent of the native74M CT surface; the separate solid proxy has a slightly different bound.

source_scanner_mm_to_solution_m.input_frame: Corrected18um scanner XYZ in mm; native CT coordinates already in this frame.

constitutive.property_status: Assumed fossil-domain constants retained from existing pressure experiment; not measured specimen properties.

loads.patch: Frozen original L0 crown-face patch inherited by checked planar/barycentric containment
loads.support: All three displacement components zero in bilateral geometric root-cap volumes

tip_roi.definition: Frozen union of 730 original calibrated L0 tetrahedra, inherited by containment-checked child centroid assignment.
tip_roi.convergence_criterion: Q95, Q99 and integrated strain energy each change by <2% on two consecutive local refinement steps; at least four solved meshes.
tip_roi.scope: Local h-convergence on unchanged polyhedral closed-solid proxy. No original CT serration reconstruction, contact convergence or pore-resolution claim.

display_geometry.relationship: Separate unreduced CT surface for visualization and manufacturing. Stress may be projected onto it; it is not this tetrahedral solve domain.

mass_example.usage: Calculated directly by integration on this size-specific FEM proxy. Native CT mesh volume and print infill mass must be computed separately.

final.solver: CG / smoothed-aggregation AMG with six rigid-motion candidates

limitations: No measured fossil strength or material heterogeneity
Native CT internal voids are omitted by the fixed closed-solid mechanical proxy
Adaptive refinement preserves the archived coarse polyhedral surface; it cannot restore unrepresented serration anatomy
The 74M surface triangle count is not the FEM tetrahedron count
Reported h-convergence is conditional on the stated proxy, pressure patch, support and material model

download_format_notes.OBJ: ExtractZIP, keep tooth.obj and tooth.mtl in the same directory; import with unitsmillimetre. stress_vertex_values_Pa.f32 is losslessly compressed withinZIP.
download_format_notes.STL: ExtractZIP; binarySTL contains the complete triangle surface, with unitsmm in itsheader andpropertiesJSON. STL has no standard colour or unit field.
download_format_notes.3MF: Open directly in a3MF-capable application. Modelunit ismillimeter; per-corner colour and native internal void boundary topology are retained. Numerical field is included as custom metadata. Appearance depends on material-extension support.
